intro.content1: At Leader24 we believe in being transparent about the data we collect about you and how it is used. This policy provides information about cookies and how you can control them.
intro.content2: Cookies are small text files stored on your computer or mobile device when you visit our site. They allow us to make the site work, make it more secure, provide you with a better experience, and understand how it is used.

howWeUse.title: How We Use Cookies
howWeUse.intro: We use cookies for several purposes:

authentication.title: Authentication
authentication.content: We use cookies to verify your identity when you log into the Leader24 dashboard. This allows us to show you the correct information and keep your session active securely.

security.title: Security
security.content: Cookies help us protect your account and data by detecting suspicious activity or unauthorized access.

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.content: Cookies allow us to remember your preferences, such as your selected language and display settings, to provide you with a personalized experience.

analytics.title: Analytics and Performance
analytics.content: We use analytics cookies to understand how visitors interact with our site. This helps us continuously improve Leader24 and fix any issues.

marketing.title: Marketing
marketing.content: We use marketing cookies to measure the effectiveness of our advertising campaigns and show you relevant content based on your interests.

yourChoices.title: Your Choices
yourChoices.intro: You have control over cookies. You can manage your preferences in several ways:

banner.title: Cookie Banner:
banner.content: When you visit our site, you can choose which categories of cookies to accept through the banner.

browser.title: Browser Settings:
browser.content: Most browsers allow you to block or delete cookies. Check your browser settings for more details.

yourChoices.warning: Note: Disabling necessary cookies may compromise website functionality and prevent you from accessing the dashboard.

doNotTrack.title: Do Not Track Signals
doNotTrack.content: Some browsers offer a "Do Not Track" option that sends a signal to websites. We do not currently respond to these signals, but we respect your cookie choices made through our banner.

thirdParty.title: Third-Party Services
thirdParty.intro: Some cookies are set by third-party services we use. For more information about how these services handle your data, see their privacy policies:

updates.title: Updates
updates.content: We may update this Cookie Policy periodically. We encourage you to review this page regularly to stay informed about our use of cookies.
